name: Create duplicate mailbox address returns 409

steps.name: When Create mailbox with local_part "duplicate1" and save response as "firstRes"
Then Get and check status code 201 from "firstRes"
When Create mailbox with local_part "duplicate1" and save response as "secondRes"
Then Get and check status code 409 from "secondRes"
And Assert error code is "ADDRESS_TAKEN" in mail response "secondRes"

categories.name: API Defects
categories.description: API returned an unexpected response — wrong status code, error code, or missing field
